entities.summary: Germán Larrea Mota-Velasco is a Mexican business magnate. He is the CEO of Grupo México, Mexico's largest mining corporation. As of June 2025, his net worth was estimated at US$31.3 billion. He's ranked the second richest person in Latin America as of 2026.
